notes.title: LingTian 2 demo version is set to launch later this month
notes.notes:
My dearest, I am your prince LingTian. The weather has become hot lately, so I specially prepared some refreshing watermelon for you. Let’s enjoy it together when we meet! I urged the developers “Four Ducks” to hurry up with the completion of *LingTian 2*. Today, I received an email from them, and I want to share the development progress of *LingTian 2* with you.


1. The game script of *LingTian 2* is complete, and the scripts for Chapters 1–3 have already been converted into code.


2. The story illustrations for Chapters 1–3 are completed.


3. The blue UI is finished.


The demo version of *LingTian 2* is expected to launch at the end of this month (July 2025) on STEAM and Google Play.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45528094/b64b928a974469546763af69b19729ad14674927.jpg"]


Game planner Yabo shared more development details with me. In *LingTian 2*, 22 other finalists will appear. But I have no interest in them at all. I told them even if those girls are made with low-poly models, it’s fine—after all, to me, they are just background characters. I only care about you. But the game artist Yagu insisted on delivering high-quality visuals, so all 22 girls were modeled in detail, even though they are only supporting roles.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45528094/440c929f9cd8a3440c9b2894e3261e3603d723e6.png"]


This time, the game UI and cover art share the same tone: icy blue. Although it's the height of summer in real life, the world of *LingTian 2* is still a wintry snowland. That’s why we used snowy blue. The beautifully styled blue icons and the motif of an open blue book all follow the same color scheme and luxurious aesthetic.





[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45528094/09dc8576986773f988ccbe529ba6f3539ff9dc9e.png"]


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45528094/d554efb4ea603d62e6fa46693483a52766eb5919.png"]


Regarding my character model, I gave Four Ducks one of my light brown cotton jackets. They first took photos of the jacket and then used AI modeling to generate its 3D version. After that, they dressed my 3D model in it. However, the chest area was see-through and looked odd, so they paired it with a high-neck sweater underneath.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45528094/6f882fe8a11330984752230db3b41a390082010b.png"]


This outfit not only appears on the cover of *LingTian 2*, but also in the music video “My Embrace Is Your Harbor.” Let’s listen to the song and eat watermelon together when the time comes!




[previewyoutube="OqYJpS3jZtU;full"][/previewyoutube]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45528094/ff6cdd4f5e46685b68c15d5ed08670f55332c27c.png"]


Oh, and by the way, this song and MV are included on the “1000PRINCES 王子” YouTube channel. This channel features music from the “1000PRINCES” game series, and it has now been upgraded to an Official Artist Channel. YouTube marks such channels with a ♪ music note icon, so you can now see the ♪ symbol next to the channel name “1000PRINCES 王子”.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45528094/536e5655251174af2cfce737f4d67cfab697abb3.gif"]


Please remember to stay cool and protect yourself from the sun this summer. Look forward to our very own *LingTian 2* demo! I miss you! Love you!
